name: lighttable-build
description: Build tooling for Light Table's ClojureScript and main-process sources.

scripts.build:cljs: npm run --silent build:window && npm run --silent build:worker && npm run --silent build:browser && tsc -p plugins/TypeScript/tsconfig.json && shadow-cljs release app worker bootstrap && node script/prune-cljs-cache.mts && npm run --silent deps:plugins && node script/place-plugins.mts && npm run --silent place:user-plugin
scripts.build:plugins: tsc -p plugins/TypeScript/tsconfig.json && npm run --silent deps:plugins && node script/place-plugins.mts
scripts.lint:cljs: node script/fetch-clj-kondo.mts && .tools/clj-kondo --fail-level error --lint src test deploy/core/User/src plugins
scripts.lint:js: eslint script src-electron src-window src-worker src-browser test-electron test-e2e
scripts.test: npm run --silent test:cljs && npm run --silent test:electron
scripts.check: npm run --silent lint:cljs && npm run --silent lint:js && npm run --silent typecheck && npm run --silent docs:check && node script/check-pins.mts
